messages.subject: For Mike Doustdar | Global healthcare, government relations and access stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Novo Nordisk Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Maziar 'Mike' Doustdar, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Novo Nordisk's global growth operates across governments, regulators, health systems, manufacturing investments and access priorities. That complex stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across a regulated emerging-market operation.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Novo Nordisk's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Novo Nordisk.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
